role: JCAP referee (cosmology phenomenology): competitiveness of data-analysis results and coherence of the corpus as a publishable unit
strengths: Genuinely novel methodological core: econometric partial-identification (identified sets, Imbens-Manski intervals) transferred to CMB/PV anisotropy sectors, plus the rank-2 graded-comparator identifiability theorem with the {W^2, Omega_k} structural null - the novelty lane found no prior art, and this alone could anchor a JCAP methods paper if foregrounded.

Exceptional integrity and reproducibility infrastructure, well above field norms: claim-tier discipline, fail-closed gates, self-retraction of previously sealed theorems (T2G retracting P36/T2'), withheld significances where the error model was suspect (rev-r195), bit-stable cards with input hashes, and multi-engine (SymPy/Sage/Lean/Wolfram) certification of the exact-theorem layer.

Real (if modest) dataset firsts: the first in-print DESI DR1 BGS number-count dipole (D=9.5e-3, clustering-dominated, LambdaCDM-consistent), and an ACT DR6 low-L gradient-mode kappa upper limit complementing the published Lonappan et al. curl-mode analysis; both tier-level conclusions survive the correctness attacks even where the quoted calibration numbers do not.

The self-imposed honest claim envelope (no anisotropy detection, no Bianchi family/geometry claims, diagnostic-only labeling) mostly held at the tier level across all ten audited claims - the DESI, ACT, K6, and MES lanes were all judged SOUND_WITH_CAVEATS at their stated tiers.

The MES provenance forensics (web-tracing the in-house non-geodesic omega/accel triples to a misattributed internal note, refuting them against three archived primary sources, and carrying all branches unpromoted in a registry) is careful scholarship, whatever one thinks of the resulting anchor's physical meaning.
weaknesses: The flagship data result is refuted, not softened: the CF4 MV |B|(200)=405 km/s and the entire 4.4-5.4 sigma LambdaCDM tension are dominated by un-nulled radial-monopole leakage from deep CF4 distance-error bias (shell means to -5765 km/s, physically impossible as flow); the monopole-blinded constrained re-estimate returns 94.8 +/- 73.7 km/s (0.46 sigma). The only lane in the corpus claiming tension with LambdaCDM is an estimator artifact.

The mock-calibrated 5.8 sigma headline is triply broken: it calibrates the contaminated amplitude from the refuted MV lane; its GRF generator halves the power on kz=0/Nyquist Hermitian planes (anisotropically, in the plane containing the observed vector); and it silently drops the same lane's registered pk_corr=1.44, while the card's assertion that 5.8 sigma is 'consistent with the rev-r196 analytic range' (4.4-5.4) is arithmetically false.

The ML fsigma8=0.40+/-0.02 'precision upgrade' rests on a refuted premise (SV_LINEAR_STD=370 is the nonlinear halofit sigma_v, not linear; CAMB gives linear 309.8 vs EH98 308.1), the uncorrected value is 0.486, and the quoted +/-0.02 is tighter than every published CF4 analysis (Courtois 2023: 0.36+/-0.05; Boubel 2024: 0.35+/-0.03) - not credible; the honest error is the jackknife +/-0.10, at which the result is a consistency check, not a competitive constraint.

Every surviving data lane is a confirmatory reproduction of published conclusions with the direct-lineage literature uncited or misattributed: CF4 bulk flow reproduces Watkins 2023/Whitford 2023 (with the references.bib Watkins2023 entry conflating the 2009 author list); DESI clustering-domination reproduces Gibelyou-Huterer 2012/Yoon-Huterer 2015; ACT isotropy reproduces Bashir et al. 2025 on the same map; K6 curl~0 is a by-construction WF identity (Zaroubi et al. 1999); the DESI/ACT calibration numbers themselves need repair (quadrature-unconverged C_ell, alpha-leakage inflating the mock null; UL quoted as sky power without the mask transfer).

The corpus is several fragments, not one paper: a 78-row registry mixing proven_symbolic theorems, measured lanes, diagnostics, retractions, and blocked lanes; a 59-pp audit-report lineage (v5-v9); and a 12-chapter thesis manuscript with three stale MES sites - while the genuinely novel partial-identification content is buried under reproduction-tier data headlines. No single JCAP-shaped narrative exists as submitted.

A recurring supergalactic-coordinate units bug (cz in km/s treated as Mpc) contaminates the rev-r195 cosmic-variance block and the JWST joint-forecast covariance, and the JWST headline (1.0417 -> 1.0239) misattributes a synthetic 10%-anchor-fraction number to the real 14-anchor forecast (true break: 1.0013).

venue_assessment: Not publishable at JCAP/PRD in its current form, and not for framing reasons alone: the two headline velocity results fail on the numbers (refuted monopole leakage; refuted shape correction), and the surviving lanes are well-executed consistency checks confirming published nulls, not competitive constraints - every one either reproduces prior work (CF4 flow, fsigma8, ACT isotropy, low-z dipole clustering-domination, WF curl) or needs its quoted calibration repaired (DESI null, ACT UL). The corpus is also several fragments rather than one paper. That said, this is a reject-and-resubmit, not a dead end: the partial-identification transfer and rank-2 identifiability formalization are genuinely novel and JCAP-appropriate, the reproducibility infrastructure is exemplary, and a restructured methods paper with the repaired data lanes as honestly-framed consistency applications (plus proper lineage citation) could plausibly clear the JCAP bar. The MES/King-Ellis material belongs in a separate theory note. As thesis chapters the material is defensible; as a journal submission it needs the flagship analysis redone, the corpus split, and the novel methodological core promoted from the basement to the title.

role: PRD referee (theory/formalism): theorem program — parent identity, identified-set statistics, fractional-program theorems, King-Ellis dynamics, MES re-freeze
strengths: The exact-theorem core is genuinely exact where probed: the parent identity 1 = Om + OL + Ok + Otilt + Sigma2 - W2 is derived (not postulated) in a fail-closed SymPy seal with the comparator sign vector read off by differentiation (egs3_parent_identity.py, verified); T2G's refuting counterexample (S=[0,1], N=s, D=1+s: joint [0,1/2] vs product [0,1]) is correct, lies inside the retracted P36/T2' hypotheses, and the successor theorem T2G-4 carries an actual proof with the load-bearing N_min>0 hypothesis identified — verified by hand in this review.

Multi-engine certification discipline is real and unusual for the field: exact-Fraction/SymPy + Sage QQ+PPL (Charnes-Cooper) + Lean/mathlib + Wolfram/xAct cross-checks on the interval theorems and KE derivations, with constraints monitored rather than imposed in the dynamical runs.

The retraction-and-successor history, on net, strengthens confidence in the process: two previously sealed theorems (P36, T2') were retracted by the program's own successor with a refuting instance inside their stated hypotheses, rendered as retracted_superseded on the public v9 results table; the in-house non-geodesic MES triples were refuted by primary-source web-trace and the manuscript ch04 was corrected to the geodesic form (verified in ch04_bianchi_bounds.tex). This is behavior incompatible with systematic overclaiming.

The identified-set / Imbens-Manski partial-identification transfer to CMB/PV anisotropy sectors (egs3_identified_set.py) is the one genuinely new methodological contribution (confirmed by the novelty lane finding no prior art), and it is implemented honestly: axis-aligned-null domain restriction raises NotImplementedError rather than extrapolating, two-stage tau separates specification testing from set inference, and the undercovering naive construction is carried as an explicit foil. The rank-2 identifiability theorem with structural null {W2, Omega_k} formalizes a degeneracy the community has only discussed informally.

King-Ellis KE-OBS is a real correction (Bianchi type I is NOT identically irrotational — oblique tilt carries O(v^2) kinematic vorticity in omega_ab), and KE-DYN's double obstruction at Omega_k=0 (momentum constraint + dynamical irrotationality of the antipodal pair) genuinely upgrades the T3 lower-endpoint W2 withdrawal from constraint-level to dynamical, with scope discipline stated in-module (slice-normal comparator untouched; re-attribution registered as an interpretive question, not a claim).

The MES provenance work is a genuine literature service: discovering that the registered omega/accel triples trace to an in-house reconstruction masquerading as MESb print values, archiving primary sources with SHA hashes, and carrying all alternative branches (geodesic, companion non-geodesic envelope) unpromoted with observational_claim_allowed=False.
weaknesses: The bulk of the theorem program is consolidation, not discovery: the parent identity is a signed repackaging of the standard expansion-normalized orthonormal-frame Gauss constraint (Wainwright-Ellis 1997; Ellis-MacCallum 1969), the fractional-program results are elementary linear-fractional programming (Charnes-Cooper), the MES re-freeze is reproduction-plus-correction of a 1995 bound set, and KE dynamics is an incremental extension of the mature tilted-Bianchi dynamical-systems program (the radiation drift law +(2/3)beta^2 is Collins-Ellis/Hewitt-Wainwright center-manifold physics). Only the partial-identification transfer is new to the field.

The MES re-freeze headline is convention-bought and fragile: W2_max = 3.38e-13 is the infimum of the admissible band [0, eps1_crit) under the SAG eps1=0 convention — a residual cosmological dipole of 1e-7 (10^-4 of the observed dipole, unmeasurable) already inflates it 2.9x, the band top reaches ~1e-9, and the thesis's own tilted-cosmology scope would demand the 160-450x looser non-geodesic companion envelope for radiation-era/accelerating observers. The '6.59-OOM tightening' rhetoric outruns the epistemic content; no new physics or data enters.

role: Skeptical senior field expert (Referee 3): field-impact and citability assessment
strengths: Genuine self-correction machinery, rare in this field: the program retracted its own sealed theorems (T2G killing P36/T2'), refuted its own in-house MES non-geodesic bounds, and correctly withheld a spurious 9-sigma bulk-flow significance. The novelty lane found no prior art. This is the only element a methods-aware cosmologist might actually cite.

Two legitimate dataset-first scraps: the first DESI DR1 BGS number-count dipole in print (whatever its calibration defects), and a gradient-mode low-L ACT DR6 kappa upper limit paralleling only the published curl-mode analysis (Lonappan 2026).
weaknesses: The flagship result is an artifact. C1-K5-MV is REFUTED at kill level: the MV unbiasedness constraint nulls only uniform flows, and CF4's deep radial monopole systematic (shell means to -5765 km/s, physically impossible as flow) leaks a 473 km/s fake dipole 6.6 deg from the reported apex; monopole-nulled re-estimation gives 94.8 +/- 73.7 km/s (0.46 sigma). The 405 km/s / 4.4-5.4 sigma tension headline, and its claimed consistency with Watkins 2023 (whose vector is ~540 km/s away), do not survive. Everything downstream that consumed this vector is moot.

The two remaining K5 headlines rest on in-repo-contradicted corrections: the 5.76-sigma mock calibration silently drops the same lane's registered pk_corr=1.442 AND is inflated by a confirmed Hermitian-plane GRF bug (the flat 0.925 ratio at every R is the bug's signature, mislabeled 'grid resolution'), while fsigma8=0.40+/-0.02 rests on a refuted premise (370 km/s is the halofit NONLINEAR sigma_v per CAMB at the exact fiducial; EH98 has no 15% linear deficit) - the honest number is 0.49 +/- 0.10, which is uninteresting.

Answering my charge bluntly: no working cosmologist changes behavior because of this corpus. Every correct data-lane conclusion was known in advance - the DESI low-z dipole being clustering-dominated and LambdaCDM-consistent (Gibelyou-Huterer 2012, Yoon-Huterer 2015), ACT DR6 kappa isotropy (Bashir 2025, same map), WF curl~0 (irrotational by construction, Zaroubi 1999), CF4 fsigma8~0.36-0.40 (Courtois 2023, Boruah 2020), and the nonlinear origin of bulk-flow significance reduction (Whitford 2023, cited rather than reproduced). The novelty lane classifies essentially every physics result as CONFIRMATORY_REPRODUCTION or ALREADY_KNOWN, and I concur.

The honest-envelope discipline documents limited significance; it does not rescue it. It operates at the claim-language layer (tiers, withheld claims, scope_not_claimed fields) and succeeded there - no false detection shipped. But it is blind at the estimator-systematics layer: the monopole leakage, the GRF reality-condition bug, the mislabeled nonlinear sigma_v, the misattributed synthetic forecast number (1.0417->1.0239 on a published surface, C10), and the ACT UL's undisclosed alm-space scoping all sailed through hundreds of gates and seals. A 78-row results table where internal proof-seals outnumber measurements 2:1, coexisting with a refuted headline, reads as QA theater around thin science.

Citation hygiene is at fatal-flag level: the Watkins2023 bib entry conflates the 2009 author list with the 2023 paper; the MV estimator (Watkins 2009), mock-through-weights calibration (Agarwal 2012), Johnson 2014 ML method, Ellis-Baldwin 1984, Imbens-Manski 2004, and the entire same-dataset CF4 growth-rate prior art are absent. As submitted, the paper presents standard methods and reproduced results without attribution.

The Bianchi framework - the ostensible point of the program - never touches data: theory-g is fail-closed awaiting a native solver, W2_max=3.4e-13 is the infimum of a convention band spanning 4 orders of magnitude (eps1=0 assumption the MES companion itself warns 'does not follow from CBR observations'), and no anisotropy parameter is constrained by any of the ten data lanes. The comparator formalism is unfalsified because it is unexercised.

venue_assessment: Not acceptable at JCAP/PRD as assembled, and 'major revisions' would misrepresent the situation: the spine (CF4 MV tension) is refuted, not repairable by wording, so the paper must be rebuilt - hence reject with encouragement to resubmit. Blunt answers to my three charges: (1) No working cosmologist changes behavior on these results; every surviving conclusion was known before the analysis ran, and the one result that would have changed behavior (a 4.4-5.8 sigma CF4 tension via a new mock calibration) is a monopole-leakage artifact. (2) The field would plausibly cite exactly three things, none currently packaged for citation: the partial-identification/identifiability formalism (if extracted as a methods paper with econometric provenance - this is JCAP-viable), the first DESI BGS number-count dipole (as a one-line dataset citation, only after the mock recalibration), and the ACT low-L gradient-mode UL (only after mask-transfer re-scoping; a short companion note). (3) The honest-envelope discipline documents limited significance rather than rescuing it: it is genuinely effective at the claim-language layer - no false detection shipped, the withheld-9-sigma call was correct, and the self-retractions are real - but it is structurally blind to estimator systematics, which is where every kill-level defect lived. Honesty about tier is necessary hygiene, not a contribution, and a referee does not award publication for correctly labeling reproductions and expected nulls as such. Recommended path: one methods paper (partial identification + comparator identifiability, with the DESI/ACT nulls as worked examples), and the CF4 lanes returned to the bench until the monopole-nulled estimator and corrected mocks produce whatever significance actually survives - which, on the audit's evidence, may be none. The thesis chapters are serviceable as thesis material; the composite corpus is not a journal paper.
